I’m not sure I’ve noticed it that way.\n\nMy sister used to say you can tell a person’s mood by whether they open the curtains in the morning—she had these yellow curtains, terrible to wash, caught every bit of dust—anyway, I guess I don’t keep track close enough. I guess it’s mostly the choir and the senior center things. I used to be the one who helped keep the choir together—well, not all by myself, but I knew the hymns, and I liked when we’d practice for Christmas, because my mother used to sing those same songs in the kitchen.
